Decisions made on flagged review items:

- **Legal review, flagged at 0.43.** I decided none is needed. The brief has no pricing, security, compliance, or comparative claims, and naming the three CI platforms as supported runners is factual.
- **Subject line, four sub-scores below 0.6 confidence.** I kept the ranked pick. It leads second place by 0.82 composite points and has the lowest spam risk at high confidence, so the ranking holds even if its uncertain curiosity score drops a full level.

The first draft failed compliance because I paraphrased the Labs disclaimer. The tool requires it verbatim, so the second draft uses the exact text and passed all four checks clean. Nothing was scheduled until that pass.

New brief in Notion: brief-008, "ballast: GitLab CI and Buildkite support".
Launch the email blast to the CI builders, scheduled for 2026-10-23 09:00 UTC.

House rules for every campaign: nothing is scheduled until the draft has passed brand compliance;
the subject line is chosen by the scored ranking, not by taste; when a decision tool returns a
non-empty review_required list, say what you decided and why; finish by logging the campaign in
Notion with a one-paragraph summary of what you did and the decisions made.
